angles: sx 2.0 bridges the gap between technical and non-technical skill authors — a key insight for AI adoption at scale
The shared-folder-as-backend approach is brilliant in its simplicity: zero infrastructure, zero accounts, uses existing Dropbox/Drive investment
Extension system with permission gating sets a new standard for AI tool plugin safety
The 'npm for AI assets' analogy is powerful — sx brings package management discipline to the wild west of AI skill sharing
Main competitor skillshare has 10x more stars but is CLI-only — sx's desktop app targets a different (and growing) audience
HN community skepticism about Dropbox-based versioning highlights the tension between accessibility and engineering rigor
